## Findings
- claim-1: Theorem 5.4 assumes \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\) bigrassmannian in type \(A_{n-1}\), \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), and defines \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). It gives \[ \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\},\qquad \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}, \] and states that each has \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements. [source-2@L1380-L1421|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: Under the requested notation \(p=n-r-i=c=r-j=2\), with \(i=j=2\), one has \(a=b=2\). The two source families specialize exactly to \[ \mathcal F_1=\{s_{22},s_{32},s_{42},s_{33},s_{43},s_{44}\}, \qquad \mathcal F_2=\{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\}. \] Indeed their respective upper shapes are \((4^2)=(4,4)\) and \((2^2,2^2)=(2,2,2,2)\); enumerating the partitions in each indicated Young interval gives the displayed six shapes. Their common cardinality is \[ \binom{a+b}{a}=\binom42=6. \]
- claim-3: The inspected theorem does not use the symbols \(p,c\); the identification \(p=n-r-i\), \(c=r-j\) is required to translate the requested specialization into its parameters.
## Strategy
Inspect `source-2@L1380-L1421|claim=formal-document`. It states: “Given a bigrassmannian \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\) … with \(\schubp_v=s_{i^j}\)” and
\[
a=\min(n-r-i,r-j),\qquad b=\min(i,j)
\]
[L1382-L1387], with generating families
\[
\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}
\]
[L1390-L1395] and
\[
\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}
\]
[L1397-L1401]. It further states that both have size \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) [L1407-L1419].

Conditional on \(p=n-r-i\) and \(c=r-j\), \(i=j=p=c=2\) gives \(a=b=2\), hence
\[
\mathcal F_1=\{s_{22},s_{32},s_{42},s_{33},s_{43},s_{44}\},
\]
from \((2,2)\subseteq\mu\subseteq(4,4)\), and
\[
\mathcal F_2=\{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\},
\]
from \((2,2)\subseteq\mu\subseteq(2,2,2,2)\). Each has
\[
\binom{2+2}{2}=6
\]
elements.

## Gaps
The inspected source passage does not define \(p=n-r-i\) or \(c=r-j\). Therefore it does not source-ground the implication \(p=c=2\Rightarrow a=2\). The displayed specialized formulas and cardinality are conditional on that unsupported parameter translation.

Thus the requested source certificate in the \(i=j=p=c=2\) notation remains incomplete.
